captions.detailed: An anti-ram rising wedge vehicle barrier designed to sit flush with the road surface. It consists of a dark gray rectangular outer channel frame and a lighter gray steel wedge plate that sits perfectly inside the frame. The inner plate is designed to rise vertically via a prismatic joint to act as a physical barrier blocking vehicle traffic.
captions.instruction: Generate an anti-ram rising wedge vehicle barrier with a dark gray rectangular road-level channel frame and a flush inner wedge plate. The inner plate should be connected to the frame via a prismatic joint along the vertical axis, allowing it to lift and block vehicle passage.
captions.factory: The code constructs two main components using box primitives: a base frame and a rising wedge plate. The base frame is modeled as a hollowed-out rectangular box container using boolean subtraction or nested boxes. The inner wedge plate is modeled as a slightly smaller solid box that fits flush inside the frame. These two parts are connected using a prismatic joint articulation defined with an upward vertical axis vector.
